summary: Rebuilds a target list by transferring every node of a source list: for each source node it searches the source list for the node whose data pointer matches the head's, unlinks it, frees the type-1 node buffer and the node, then allocates a fresh 12-byte node carrying the same data pointer and prepends it to the target list. Sets a sentinel at this+0x30 and maintains head/tail/anchor/count fields on both lists. Called during UI widget destroy and buffer pool initialization.

operations.description: Write sentinel literal -51331646 to this+0x30 (this[12]) once on entry.
Outer loop iterates while the source head pointer at this+0x20 (this[8]) is non-null.
Copy source head this+0x20 into the source cursor/anchor this+0x28 (this[10]).
If source head this+0x20 is null, return it immediately.
Read the data pointer from the head node; if it is null, return the null node pointer.
Inner search walks node[1] (next) pointers until a node whose data pointer equals the head's data pointer is found, or the list is exhausted.
Unlink the found node: if a predecessor exists set predecessor[1] to the node's next, otherwise advance the source head this+0x20 to the node's next.
If the found node was the source cursor this+0x28, advance the cursor to the node's next.
If the found node was the source tail this+0x24, set the tail to the predecessor node.
Decrement the source list count at this+0x2C (this[11]).
If the node's flag byte at node+8 is non-zero and the node data pointer is non-null, free the node's data buffer.
Call EmptyStub_0170 before freeing the node's data buffer.
FreeWrapper_7bcf frees the node's data buffer.
FreeWrapper_7bcf frees the node struct itself.
OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(12) allocates a fresh 12-byte node; on failure the node pointer is null.
Initialize the new node: data pointer set to the transferred value, next set to null, flag byte at node+8 cleared.
Prepend the new node to the target list: if target head this+0x10 is non-null link new node's next to it, otherwise set both target tail this+0x14 and target anchor this+0x18 to the new node.
Set the target list head this+0x10 to the new node.
Increment the target list count at this+0x1C (this[7]).
Return the source head once it becomes null at the start of an iteration.
